Using AIMER Society

Updated 16 October 2026

Learning and accounts

This dashboard helps you discover educational tools and learning websites. Browsing does not require an account. Google sign-in enables your profile and synced dashboard preferences.

Responsible use

Use your own account. Do not attempt to access another person's data, bypass access controls, disrupt the service, or use the platform unlawfully. Keep your Google account secure and sign out on shared devices.

Connected resources

Subject websites, apps, and third-party resources may have their own terms and privacy practices. Dashboard favorites and recent activity are convenience features; keep independent copies of information you need. Educational resources may change or be unavailable.

Questions

Use the contact information on the AIMER Society website for support. Read our Privacy Policy to understand account and learning-data storage.
